name: dataset/views.py
summary: Django REST Framework ViewSet exposing CRUD and file upload endpoints for Dataset resources, delegating business logic to DatasetService.
purpose: Provides a centralized HTTP API interface for dataset management, separating web concerns from business logic through a service layer and using specialized serializers for different operations.
responsibilities: Expose RESTful endpoints for dataset CRUD operations
Handle multipart file uploads for dataset ingestion
Enforce authentication and dataset ownership permissions
Route requests to DatasetService for business logic execution
Serialize dataset data using context-specific serializers (list, detail, upload)
inputs: HTTP requests with JSON payload for dataset metadata
Dataset primary keys from URL parameters
outputs: HTTP Response objects with serialized dataset data
architecture_notes: Implements the ViewSet pattern from Django REST Framework with a Service Layer architecture. Uses multiple specialized serializers (List, Detail, Upload) to optimize payload shapes for different operations. Custom IsDatasetOwner permission enforces resource-level authorization. MultiPartParser and FormParser support file-based dataset uploads. Business logic is delegated to DatasetService, keeping views thin and focused on HTTP transport concerns.
improvements: Add explicit pagination and filtering configuration for the list endpoint
Introduce comprehensive OpenAPI schema documentation annotations
Add explicit exception handling to map DatasetService errors to HTTP responses
Consider implementing asynchronous task delegation for large dataset uploads
Add rate limiting and file size validation for upload endpoints
Document the rationale for splitting serializers across separate modules
